name: oracles-extend-yarn
description: Yarn-only Foundry-aware target validation after the Oracle Comparison extension. Named install allows fingerprint skip across attempts. Initializes Forge submodules (Chainlink/Pyth) before compile. Uses next:lint + foundry:compile + next:build (root yarn lint hits known prettier noise in foundry scripts-js).

commands.name: install
commands.purpose: Install Next.js and Foundry workspaces with Yarn (pilot is yarn-only).

commands.name: submodules
commands.purpose: Fetch Foundry lib submodules required by Chainlink and Pyth adapters.

commands.name: compile
commands.purpose: Compile Foundry oracle adapters and consumer to confirm the Solidity workspace stays healthy.
